$-x^{4}-2\sqrt[5]{x^{3}}-\frac{3}{x^{3}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(-x^{4}-2\sqrt[5]{x^{3}}-\frac{3}{x^{3}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(-x^{4}-2x^{\frac{3}{5}}-3x^{-3}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -\int x^{4}\,\mathrm{d}x-2\int x^{\frac{3}{5}}\,\mathrm{d}x-3\int x^{-3}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= -\left(\frac{x^{4+1}}{(4+1)}\right)-2\left(\frac{x^{\frac{3}{5}+1}}{(\frac{3}{5}+1)}\right)\\ &\quad -3\left(\frac{x^{-3+1}}{(-3+1)}\right)+C\\ &= -\frac{x^{5}}{5}-\frac{5\sqrt[5]{x^{8}}}{4}+\frac{3}{2x^{2}}+C.\end{aligned}
